description:
At Globus Medical, we move with a sense of urgency to deliver innovations that improve the quality of life of patients with musculoskeletal disorders. Our team is inspired by the needs of these patients, and the surgeons and healthcare providers who treat them. We embrace a culture of exceptional response by partnering with researchers and educators to transform clinical insights into tangible solutions. Our solutions improve the techniques and outcomes of surgery so patients can resume their lives as quickly as possible. 
 
 Position Summary 
 Our rapidly growing Medical Robotics and Imaging division is seeking an experienced Field Service Engineer (FSE) to provide technical expertise and regional operational support across EMEA. This role combines hands-on field service responsibilities with coordination, technical leadership, team support, and oversight of assigned field service activities.
 
 The FSE will be responsible for the installation, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and ongoing support of complex medical robotics and imaging systems. The role will ensure the highest standards of quality, regulatory compliance, customer satisfaction, and service delivery, while supporting consistency and operational excellence across the wider field service team.
 The successful candidate will be a self-motivated, solutions-focused professional who is comfortable working independently in a fast-paced environment while also providing technical guidance, mentoring, and support to colleagues.
 This position operates under a flexible working model, providing schedule flexibility while guaranteeing a 40-hour working week .
 Flexible daily start and finish times based on customer and business requirements.

 Guaranteed 40 hours per week.

 Working hours driven by service demand, travel requirements, and workload priorities.

 Requires a high level of ownership, accountability, organisation, and time management.

 Suited to experienced, self-directed professionals who can effectively manage their own workload.

 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Act as a technical subject matter expert, providing regional operational support to Field Service Management while maintaining a strong hands-on field service presence.

 Coordinate FSE scheduling, workload allocation, and resource planning across the assigned region.

 Provide technical and administrative support for assigned work orders and field service activities.

 Act as a quality control point of contact for field tools, processes, documentation, and service execution.

 Support the onboarding, development, and continuous technical development of field service personnel.

 Maintain assigned field service equipment, tools, spare parts, and inventory to ensure operational readiness.

 Lead and support project coordination, including system installations, upgrades, deployments, and complex escalations.

 Deliver and support technical training initiatives for Field Service Engineers.

 Collaborate with internal teams and external customers to effectively plan and execute service activities.

 Diagnose and resolve complex electromechanical, imaging, and system-related issues, restoring equipment to full operational status as efficiently as possible.

 Ensure all service activities, customer complaints, repairs, and customer feedback are accurately and promptly documented in accordance with company procedures.

 Respond to customer issues and escalations with urgency, professionalism, and a strong customer-focused approach.

 Identify and implement opportunities to improve service processes, documentation, operational efficiency, and field performance.

 Support the Field Service Management team with regional operational activities and projects as required.

 Travel domestically and internationally across EMEA as required.

 Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

 
 Qualifications 
 
 Education 
 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Electronics, or a related technical discipline preferred.

 Equivalent relevant technical experience will also be considered.

 
 Experience 
 Minimum of 5 years’ experience as a Field Service Engineer within a technical service environment.

 Experience within the medical device industry strongly preferred , particularly in medical robotics, imaging, X-ray, or other complex medical equipment.

 Demonstrable experience troubleshooting complex electromechanical and/or imaging systems.

 Previous experience providing technical leadership, mentoring, training, or supervisory support is strongly preferred.

 Experience working within hospital or healthcare environments is highly desirable.

 
 Knowledge, Skills & Abilities 
 Strong understanding of healthcare environments, including Biomedical Engineering, Radiology, Clinical Services, and hospital operations.

 Working knowledge of EMEA healthcare, radiology, hospital regulations, and applicable quality systems.

 Strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across complex electromechanical and imaging systems.

 Excellent organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a flexible, self-directed working environment.

 Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with confidence engaging with customers, clinical teams, engineers, and internal stakeholders.

 Strong customer service mindset with the ability to manage challenging situations and escalations professionally.

 Ability to work independently while contributing effectively as part of a wider regional team.

 Strong decision-making skills and the ability to make practical, business-aligned decisions in a dynamic environment.

 Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant service management/documentation systems.

 Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate service documentation and compliance.

 
 Additional Requirements 
 Willingness and ability to travel at short notice across the assigned EMEA geography.

 High mobility and easy access to EMEA countries is essential due to the regional nature of the role.

 Ability to maintain hospital credentialing, site access, and vendor compliance requirements.

 Ability to work flexible hours in line with customer and business requirements.

 Ability to lift and handle equipment weighing up to 50 lbs (approximately 23 kg) .

 Valid driving licence and ability to travel independently within the assigned territory.

 Fluent in English

 
 Starting salary EUR 40,000 per annual plus benefits and bonus.
 
 Our Values : 
 Our Life Moves Us philosophy is built on four values: Passionate About Innovation, Customer Focused, Teamwork, and Driven. 
 Passionate about Innovation : Improving patient care by delivering advanced technology to our customers is at the core of what we do. We are passionate in our role in improving the lives of patients by continuously developing better solutions. 

 Customer Focused : We listen to our customers’ needs and respond with a sense of urgency. 

 Teamwork : Working together, anything is possible. We value every person on our team and treat each other with respect. We are accountable to one another and support each other. Together, we make each other stronger. 

 Driven : We pursue our mission with energy and passion. We are nimble, results-oriented and decisive. We overcome obstacles that arise in our quest to deliver solutions that will improve the lives of our customers and patients. 

   
 Equal Employment Opportunity : 
 Globus Medical is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, national origin or citizenship. We are committed to a diverse workforce. We value all employees’ talents and support an environment that is inclusive and respectful. 
   
 Other Duties : 
 Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.
